author: Yihao
title: Repository and progress site set up
body: Created the shared repo on top of nu-microbit-base. Added central and player firmware skeletons plus a shared radio protocol (software/lib/protocol.h) with sequence numbers, ACKs and a 1 s player timeout. Both apps build; next step is testing the radio link on two boards.

author: Team
title: Project proposal submitted
body: Pocket Rivals proposal finished: two player boards plus one central board, TFT displays, joysticks, pressure sensors and DFPlayer audio.
